mentions.name: Radiodock
mentions.description: An online radio player for community radio stations. Station search is currently powered by the Radio Browser API, with a custom station API providing proper metadata and thumbnail coverage in development, plus a planned station discovery page showing the most played stations.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I‘m working on an online radio player for community radios.
https://radiodock.app

Search is currently provided by the Radio Browser API, but I'm now building my own station API with proper metadata and thumbnail coverage. A station discovery page with most played stations is also in the making.
